Looking at the TDS stuff

```{r}
library(arrow)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
library(spsurvey)
library(dplyr)

#read in the merged data file from probabilistic_initial_data_workup
#write to RDS to use in other scripts
stream_df_merged<-readRDS(here::here("outputs/Probabilistic_data_workup_2_6_25.rds"))


```
create the TDS converstions
```{r}

tds<-stream_df_merged |> 
  filter(PARAMETER_NAME %in% c("specific_conductance"),
         UNIT %in% "uS/cm")

tds<-tds |> 
  mutate(tds_ai_vibe = RESULT_VALUE *0.67,
         tds_dec = (RESULT_VALUE * 0.563565)+3.965894)




```

create the regional estimates, first we'll divide teh adjusted weight by all survey years (3) so we can have them all count in the same data set

```{r}
tds<-tds |> 
  mutate(adj_wgt_all = adj_wgt/3) #adjust teh weights
  
#create the regional estimates

tds<-tds %>% 
  dplyr::rename(latitude = LATITUDE,
         longitude = LONGITUDE) |> 
  filter(adj_wgt_all>0)

#create sf objectt
tds.sf <- sf::st_as_sf(tds,
  coords = c("longitude", "latitude"),
  crs = "+proj=longlat +datum=WGS84 +no_defs"
)

#run the spsurvey data
cont_ests_tds <- spsurvey::cont_analysis(tds.sf,
  siteID = "SITE_ID",
  vars = "tds_dec",
  subpops = "BASIN.x",
  weight = "adj_wgt_all" #using the adjusted weights calculatd on 11/22/22 KAR
)

cont_ests_tds$Mean

ggplot(cont_ests_tds$CDF, aes(Value, Estimate.P,colour = Subpopulation)) + 
  geom_line()+
  scale_colour_hue(name="")+
  xlab("")+
  ylab("Estimated Proportion of Stream Miles in NYS")+
  theme_classic()

df<-cont_ests_tds$Mean

plot<-ggplot2::ggplot(df, aes(x=factor(df$Subpopulation), y=df$Estimate)) +
  geom_bar(stat="identity",aes(fill=df$Subpopulation)) +
  geom_crossbar( aes(x=factor(df$Subpopulation), y=df$Estimate, ymin=df$LCB95Pct, ymax=df$UCB95Pct), colour="grey", alpha=0.5, size=0.5, fill = "grey")+
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin= df$LCB95Pct,
                    ymax= df$UCB95Pct),
                width=.2,                    # Width of the error bars
                position="identity",
                alpha = 0.5)+
  coord_flip()+ggtitle(label = "Estimated TDS")+
  theme(legend.position = "none")


plot
  



```
